newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian c.bank issued 68 bln bfr of CDs in week.
newsitem.headline: Belgian c.bank issued 68 bln bfr of CDs in week.

text.p: The Belgian central bank has issued 68.08 billion francs worth of certificates of deposit in the week to December 2, the bank said in its weekly statement on Wednesday.
The bank has now a total 105.94 billion francs worth of CD's outstanding with Belgium's 15 primary dealers of state debt.
The CD's -- which expire on December 31, 1998 and which have revisable rates -- are issued to neutralise the impact on the money market of a 230 billion franc state debt buyback operation.
For the buyback, the bank is using capital gains on gold sales in the past years.
The capital gains on gold account in the bank's balance sheet fell by 68.07 billion francs and now stands at 123.01 billion francs.
